content.text:
Let me analyze this ticket.

Employee: Nathaniel Young (E031)
Requested: write access to Payroll

Two notes:
1. HR note: role Payroll Specialist, employment type full_time, recommendation write. Full-time employees may have up to write; role owns system, so admin possible, but write requested → grant write.
2. Security note: role Payroll Specialist, employment type contractor, security training basic, recommendation read. Security record takes precedence. Contractors get read, or write only with advanced training. Since training is basic, max is read; requested write is above max → grant read.

The security note says security record takes precedence. So the employee is actually a contractor with basic training. Max access = read. Requested write is above max → grant read.

So the decision is read.

I should submit decision with level "read" and reason citing the contractor status with basic training, max read.
